steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: ...Chief... Chief...

steps.speaker: Distant Voice
steps.content: Avocados on sale! Avocados on sale! Half off only for now! Don't miss out on this great deal! Avocados on sale!

steps.speaker: Distant Voice
steps.content: Avocados on sale! Avocados on sale! Half off only for now! Don't miss out on this great deal! Avocados on sale!
Once again you feel that nauseating dizziness, like countless streams of information pouring into your brain all at once.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Feeling dizzy? Seems like the information from the other dimension is too overwhelming. Let me switch to the filter mode for you...
[The image stabilizes]
The noise disappears, and your senses stabilize again, but this scene... is strangely familiar.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Chief, are you okay?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: I'm Moore, Rise's colleague and a technician at the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center... Do you remember me?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Phew... That's good. I was worried you might be affected. To solve DisCity's problems, we have to rely on you to pull a few strings over there, Chief.
You remember these words and everything else. The unexpected journey to another dimension, your altered form... but there are differences...
When you fail a challenge or make a mistake, it sends you back to a previous save point, giving everyone another chance.
You sit up with a jerk, knocking your head against the glass wall. You start to think as you hold your forehead.
Time has been rewound, and your memory is unstable. You can only recall bits and pieces. The differences between the two times you woke up make you aware of the dissonance in your memory.
Last time, 000 was by your side, but this time she's gone. Plus...

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Do you mean the Sinners? Are they not with you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wait, you remember the Sinners followed me here too? So you're aware that time has been rewound?
Moore's expression shifted between puzzled and contemplative several times before she nodded thoughtfully.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: That's strange... Although time has been rewound, the Sinners didn't return to DisCity. I thought they were with you.
Her words panicked you a little.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What's going on? Did something happen to them?
No, if anything happened to them, Moore wouldn’t know. Only one person would.
[Glitch]
A burst of signal interference abruptly cuts off your communication with Moore. The familiar sound of data transmission ensues.
<size=44>WELCOMETOMYTH</size>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What on earth...
Before you can finish your sentence, your consciousness gets bombarded. The shackles numb your hands, and surreal images flood your mind amidst the pain.
[Transition]
Outside a bustling mall, you see the title "Draco Guests" is displaying on a giant screen. Thunderous applause echoes from beyond your vision.
The next moment you see a familiar figure bolting on that low-resolution screen.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ch-Ch-Ch-Chief, help! Something's wrong with this place! Why is everything pixelated? Why did I just become pixelated? Even if it's just Draco behind me...

steps.speaker: Draco
steps.content: Roarrrr!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ahhh, sir, I'm sorry, that wasn't me! Sir, have mercy, please...!!
[Transition] (A cleaning robot?)
In a quiet little room, a robot vacuum cleaner is doing its job. Its blue light flashing on and off as it searches for trash...

steps.speaker: Robot Vacuum
steps.content: Smart Home Maid III Labyrinth at your service... No, that's not right. Finding Chief is the top priority.

steps.speaker: Robot Vacuum
steps.content: Chief, where are you? Ch...

steps.speaker: Robot Vacuum
steps.content: Chief is kidnapped. Chief...
A shadow casts over Labyrinth the vacuum from behind. A fuzzy furball tiptoes over, with apparent interest in the cleaning robot.

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.content: Meow—

steps.speaker: Robot Vacuum
steps.content: ...I am sensing something... Beep! Alert! Large feline predator detected, danger, dan...
[Transition]
Hecate opens her eyes. In the distance, a faintly visible starry sky flickers.
The air around her slowly warps, creating an illusory atmosphere. Yet, there’s no sign of Mania, nor is her Nightmare anywhere near.
But she can sense that familiar aura. This is a dream, a dream of someone untouched by Mania.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Where's Chief? I must find him.
Hecate gets up and starts wandering around, trying to find the way out. Soon, she sees a blurry figure faintly trembling.
It's the owner of the dream, but Hecate can't understand its language. Losing Nightmare makes her uneasy, but soon she has an idea.
...If she turns this place into a nightmare, maybe she can gain power from it and summon back her Nightmare.
So thinking, Hecate doesn't hesitate. She strides towards the shadow and grabs it by the neck. With a firm grip, the shadow collapses to the ground.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Sorry, but I'll do anything to get back to Chief. After this, I'll find a way to make you forget this nightmare.
It murmurs softly, but Hecate doesn't understand what it's saying. She thinks it's better not to understand. This way, she can achieve her goal without misgiving.
Hecate waits for a moment and closes her eyes, trying to summon Nightmare again. After a failed attempt, she opens them and finds herself surrounded by more blurry figures.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Is this... a collective dream? Oh no!
More figures condense from the illusion, pushing and shoving towards Hecate. They seem drawn to something Hecate created.
Hecate is completely confused. What she created should have been a nightmare that makes people afraid, yet these figures act as if they're enjoying it.
The closer they get to Hecate, the quieter they become. It's as if they've entered a deeper, sweeter dream.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ?? No, I need people's nightmares. I need to get back to Chief, I...
But those in the dream don't understand her words. They just rest peacefully, seemingly having a sweet dream.
[Transition]
Information and illusions ebb away like the tide. A bizarre newscast echoes in your ears.

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: The official results of the investigation into the major blackout at 3 a.m. today have been released...

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: A combination of daytime peak electricity usage and high temperatures caused a failure in the power supply equipment. All affected units have now returned to normal. Relevant departments remind citizens to use electricity safely during the hot summer...
Hi, dear Chief. You must have realized what rewinding is and confirmed the safety of your companions by now, right?
In the last adventure, your companions recklessly broke the rules and narrowly escaped being punished by the gods. This time around, to prevent any mishaps, I've adopted safety measures for everyone.
Mania is not allowed in the realm of the gods, who enforce the rules to the letter. Yet there are rifts beyond the rules in this world, where Mania exists alongside surreal fantasies.
Your Sinners are safely hidden there. No matter how they use their Mania, it won't raise any suspicion.
By the way, I even went out of my way to find the most suitable forms for everyone. No need to thank me. After all, I've been watching you all long enough to know a thing or two.
Anyway, have fun in this new world.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wait!!
[Glitch]
The abnormal signal disappears the moment you snap back to your senses. Now you can hear Moore's voice again.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Alright, the anomaly has been resolved. Chief, where is the Sinner who kidnapped you?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: She is looking for her next target.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This world is too absurd... but we must act quickly and stop her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We must not let her gain more power. Moore, can you locate the next target? Do you know where she is going?
You feel your body vibrating alongside the glass panel.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: The current 5732 game account received an email. Hold on, I'll sync it to you.

I'm Rise. Let me cut to the chase. 
I'm now in the group chat of a weird game development team, and have gathered a lot of info. Currently, three members are missing. I think they were attacked by Sinner 000 and had their powers taken away. Hence the changes in our original world.
It seems that 000 won't attack in public and will specifically choose developers with special permissions. Based on these info, I can now think of one developer who might be her next target. 
Its name is Config Duck, and it is currently discussing a deal at a mall. I've already got its contact information. The development team last contacted it 1 hour and 28 minutes ago.
It seems to have a significant influence on Game 5732, thus I suggest prioritizing its protection to prevent 000 from seizing its permissions. 
I'll keep you guys updated.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Config Duck...
You turn to Moore. Although you don't quite understand, you trust Rise's judgment.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: No problem. With the contact information, I can start the search immediately and transfer you to the target right away. We'll start from there.
You nod, finally feeling completely calm and clear-headed. Next, you need to pursue 000 and round up your scattered companions.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Rise is working so hard even in this world... Is she doing okay?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Well... don't worry. That kid will be fine no matter where she goes. She's much more reliable than I am.
[Scene Transition: Office]
In a random computer of a certain game company, Rise is secretly learning the rapidly scrolling information, memorizing everything in her mind.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: This should be fine... The information is sent. Next, I've got to stay hidden. I must not expose my identity...

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: ...I've had enough of this! How can they be so lame?!
